changed: Native Connection interface — the single internal request representation (Sprint 79). A typed Connection dataclass (blackbull.Connection) is now BlackBull's one internal model of a request. The protocol actors build it directly in their parsers, and the router, dispatcher, and handlers read it. The ASGI scope dict is demoted to a derived view (Connection.as_scope() / Connection.from_scope()).
deprecated: blackbull.Request → use blackbull.Connection. The opt-in handler context object was renamed. blackbull.Request is now a deprecated alias of Connection that emits a DeprecationWarning on first attribute access. Migrate by renaming the import and the parameter annotation — the members are identical, with one rename: request.scope (a stored dict) becomes conn.as_scope() (a freshly-derived dict).

fixed: gRPC server-streaming Watch flakiness (DEADLINE_EXCEEDED). H2 sender's trailers-coalescing optimisation buffered the first DATA frame when trailers: True was set, deferring the write until trailers arrived. For server-streaming handlers that park after the first yield, the buffered frame was never flushed, starving the client. Added call_soon auto-flush.

added: HTTP QUERY method support (RFC 10008, Sprint 78 P1). First-mover support for the first new standard HTTP method since PATCH — safe, idempotent, cacheable, with a request body. New blackbull.QUERY plain-string constant. Routing, body access (body: bytes / Request.json()), 405 Allow advertisement, and the four request-lifecycle events are pinned by tests over HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and TestClient.

QUERY normative response semantics (RFC 10008, Sprint 78 P2). New accept_query=[...] route option declaring the request media types a QUERY route accepts. Drives an Accept-Query response header (RFC 9651 Structured Field list). Content-Type enforcement on QUERY requests: 400 when missing, 415 when unaccepted. New blackbull.UnprocessableQuery exception (HTTPException subclass) for handlers to raise → 422.
fixed: HTTP/2: spurious http.disconnect on body-less requests. When HEADERS carried END_STREAM and the connection closed before the handler's first receive(), the synthetic empty-body fast path was disabled. The synthetic event is now delivered first; the disconnect follows it.

added: Edge inference API server positioning (Sprint 76). New guide page Edge inference serving: SSE token streaming with HTTP/2 multiplexing for interactive clients beside MQTT device ingest and $share/… work queues. Ships with runnable, dependency-free examples/edge_inference.py.
changed: Router trie fast path (Sprint 77). Static-path map short-circuits literal routes, method matching is a frozenset membership test. Parameterised _resolve dropped ~1555→959 ns, static routes ~1244→232 ns.
removed: ConnCoalescer / BB_H2_CONN_BUFFER_US (Sprint 77). The opt-in connection-level TCP-segment coalescer (default-off since v0.48.0) is removed — produced no throughput or tail-latency gain on any measured workload.
fixed: Python 3.11 compatibility restored (Sprint 77). HTTPStatus.is_client_error and .is_server_error are Python 3.12-only; importing BlackBull raised on 3.11 (regressed in 0.48.1, present through 0.57.0). Replaced with integer-range helpers; added 3.11 CI lane.

added: MQTT 5 shared subscriptions (§4.8.2, Sprint 75). Subscribers naming the same $share/{ShareName}/{filter} pair form a share group; each matching message is delivered to exactly one connected member, round-robin per group.
TLS for raw protocol bindings (Sprint 75). app.raw_handler(name, port=…, tls=True) / MQTTExtension(port=8883, tls=True) serve the binding's port through the server's TLS machinery.

Query params in the simplified handler model (Sprint 74). A handler parameter that is neither a path param, body, scope, Request, dataclass body, nor Depends now resolves from the query string, coerced to its annotation.

Depends — per-request provider injection (Sprint 74). New module blackbull.di; db=Depends(get_db) as a parameter default injects the provider's value per request. Async-generator providers yield the value and tear down after the response is sent.

RFC 9651 Structured Field Values (Sprint 73). New module blackbull.protocol.structured_fields implements the full RFC 9651 §4 parse/serialise algorithms — Items, Lists, Dictionaries, Inner Lists, Parameters, and all eight bare-item types — with zero new dependencies, verified against all 2,135 cases of the httpwg/structured-field-tests conformance suite.
Headers.get_sf_item / get_sf_list / get_sf_dict — parse a header as a Structured Field of the given type, combining multiple field lines per RFC 9651 §4.2.
Protocol translation hub showcase (Sprint 73, C4). New example examples/translation_hub.py: MQTT → WebSocket, MQTT → SSE, and REST → gRPC translation in a single BlackBull process.
fixed: MQTT @mqtt.on_message taps were dead in actor mode (the default). TapActor compiled the tap table immediately — before any @mqtt.on_message decorator had run. TapActor now tracks the live handler list and recompiles when it grows.
HTTP/2 :authority is now validated and surfaced as the host header (#150, Sprint 72; RFC 9113 §8.3.1). Previously request.headers.get(b'host') returned None for virtually every HTTP/2 client.
Experimental H2 client: send windows now honour the server's SETTINGS_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE for late streams (#151).
removed: The deprecated in-tree Session middleware (blackbull.middleware.Session). Deprecated since 0.38; migration: install blackbull-session and swap app.use(Session(...)) for SessionExtension(app, ...).

fixed: request_completed now reports the real status / byte count when a global middleware buffers the response (issue #145). Emission moved to BlackBull.__call__, after the global middleware chain returns.

MQTT 5.0 broker hardening — eight RFC-conformance bugs (Sprint 70): Keep-alive enforcement (§3.1.2.10), Session takeover (§3.1.4), QoS 2 inbound de-duplication (§4.3.3), Topic validation on PUBLISH/SUBSCRIBE, No Local and Retain As Published subscription options honoured, Shared subscriptions rejected explicitly, QoS 2 outbound + DUP replay on reconnect, Malformed CONNECT no longer drops connection on IndexError.
Compression now emits Vary: Accept-Encoding on compressible responses it does not actually compress (bug 1.21f).
Cache no longer orphans variant entries after LRU eviction (bug 1.21g). The store is now a single LRU of per-URL buckets.

added: StaticFiles conditional requests. Emits strong ETag (from mtime + size) and Last-Modified; honours If-None-Match / If-Modified-Since with 304 Not Modified.
fixed: Compression now emits Vary: Accept-Encoding on compressed responses (RFC 9110 §12.5.5, bug 1.21a).
Cache is now variant-aware (bug 1.21b). Response Vary fields folded into the cache key.
TrustedProxy parses multi-element RFC 7239 Forwarded headers correctly (bug 1.21e).

added: Router(cache_max=…) — route lookup-cache bound is now a constructor argument (default 2048; 0 disables).
fixed: ASGI conformance: scope['path'] is now percent-decoded; raw_path no longer includes the query string (Sprint 68). scope['path'] is decoded once at scope construction on every transport.
ASGI conformance: RFC 3986 ; path sub-delimiter is now preserved in path and raw_path on both transports (Sprint 68).

Send-path size gate — writelines regression (inter-sprint). BaseSender._write_many now joins parts totalling ≤ 32 KiB into a single write(); only larger payloads use vectored writelines. Recovers the full HTTP/1.1 baseline regression (−10% CPU/request vs v0.51.0).
HTTP/2 bidi stream state: client END_STREAM now half-closes, not closes (RFC 9113 §5.1). Stream now enters HALF_CLOSED_REMOTE; WINDOW_UPDATE after client END_STREAM no longer triggers RST_STREAM.
changed: Connection-accept path trims. Cleartext protocol-detection order cached on ProtocolRegistry; per-connection ids generated by new_connection_id() (12-hex prefix + 8-hex monotonic sequence) replacing per-connection uuid.uuid4().

added: blackbull[protobuf] extra → new blackbull-protobuf 0.1.0 package: add_servicer, enable_reflection (grpc.reflection.v1alpha), enable_health (grpc.health.v1 Check + Watch), abort_with_details (google.rpc.Status details in grpc-status-details-bin trailer).
fixed: gRPC error paths now deliver set_trailing_metadata. Previously dropped the context's trailing metadata on every non-OK shape.
Interactive server-streaming no longer withholds messages. Write-coalescing batcher replaced by a loop-idle flusher task.

added: Request context object for simplified handlers (from blackbull import Request). Declare request: Request and the router injects a per-request object exposing method, path, headers, cookies, client, scheme, and awaitables body() / json() / text(). Detected at registration time — no per-request reflection cost.

fixed: Request-lifecycle events fire exactly once per request, under any transport. Emission consolidated to a single choke point, BlackBull._dispatch.
HTTP/2 request_completed details carry real wire fields. HTTP/2 now publishes its access-log record the same way HTTP/1.1 does.
removed: Net −614 lines of dead code: orphaned EventEmitter utility, ~40 pre-registered identical ErrorRouter fallback entries, racy TOCTOU check_port connect-probe, parse_post_data, and other unused helpers.

security: HTTP/1.1 chunk-framing line length bound (audit 1.24, CVE-2023-39326 class): chunk-size+extension line and every trailer line capped at 8 KiB.
HTTP/1.1 prohibited trailer fields rejected (RFC 9110 §6.5.1): Transfer-Encoding, Content-Length, Host, Authorization, Content-Type, etc. in chunked trailer → 400.
HTTP/1.1 strict Content-Length (RFC 9110 §8.6): leading zeros, doubled/tab/trailing OWS rejected 400.
HTTP/1.1 underscore framing confusables: Content_Length / Transfer_Encoding header names rejected 400.
fixed: HTTP/1.1 missing Host → 400 (RFC 9112 §3.2). Unsupported HTTP major version → 505. No 100 Continue to HTTP/1.0 clients.
HTTP/2 refused multi-frame HEADERS no longer kills the connection (audit 1.14 #2).
Http11Probe re-score: 161/161 (0 failed, 5 warnings) — up from 156/161 at v0.49.2.

Consume-based inbound HTTP/2 flow control (Sprint 62). WINDOW_UPDATE credit replayed when the application consumes the event, not when the frame is enqueued — a slow handler now back-pressures the peer instead of overflowing the recipient queue into RST_STREAM(ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM).
Chunked request framing (RFC 9112 §7.1) — chunk-size token validated against strict 1*HEXDIG grammar before int(), chunk-ext grammar validated, CRLF termination enforced.
Request-target forms (RFC 9112 §3.2) — absolute-form rewritten to origin-form for routing; asterisk-form (OPTIONS *) answered server-wide 204 + Allow.
Bug 1.16 — X-Forwarded-Prefix no longer trusted off the wire. Only TrustedProxy middleware sets root_path after verifying the direct peer.

HTTP/1.1: chunked bodies split across TCP segments now reassembled whole with readexactly. A raising app_startup hook now emits lifespan.startup.failed. Double-response splice: HTTP1Sender drops response events once a response has completed.
HTTP/2: Connection-level flow control now uses one shared send window. GOAWAY early-return now signals recipients. Closed-stream tracking is bounded (LRU cap + high-water mark).
New public API: ClientDisconnected (raised by read_body on mid-body disconnect), HTTPException (status-carrying exception).

added: Client-streaming and bidirectional-streaming gRPC — all four RPC kinds now served over the ASGI bridge. Incremental Length-Prefixed-Message de-framer reassembles messages across http.request events.
gRPC gzip message compression — compressed requests decompressed with decompression-bomb guard; server advertises grpc-accept-encoding: identity,gzip.
Fuller GrpcContext — time_remaining() (from grpc-timeout), peer(), invocation_metadata(), send_initial_metadata().

fixed: IPv6 requests returned an empty reply (RFC 3986 §3.2.2). Parsing a bracketed IPv6 Host header ([::1]:8100) with split(b':') produced ValueError. Host parsing now understands the bracket form.

added: Async logging is now batch logging (BB_LOG_BATCH_SIZE, default 64). Coalesces records into one write()+flush() per batch via flusher thread.

Structured JSON logging (BB_LOG_FORMAT=json). Emits one JSON object per line instead of plain text. Access-log records expose client_ip, method, path, http_version, status, response_bytes, duration_ms.
Syslog / UDP log shipping (BB_SYSLOG_ADDR=host:port). Ships records via UDP SysLogHandler; composes with BB_LOG_FORMAT=json.
Access-log fast path — direct enqueue, bypassing logging.Logger._log. ~7.5µs → ~5.7µs per emit (−24%).
File log sink (BB_LOG_FILE=path). Async-logging sink writes to a file (append mode) instead of stderr.
Server-streaming gRPC — a gRPC handler may be an async generator that yields response messages. Verified with real grpcio unary_stream client including 5000-message flow-control shape.
scope_completed event — guaranteed, cross-protocol terminal event emitted once per ASGI scope on success or error.
Blocking observers — @app.on(name, blocking=True) adds a third event delivery mode: awaited in registration order yet isolated.
app.register_converter(type, fn) — extend simplified-handler return coercion. Pre-fork warm-up hooks (@app.on_warmup).

Unary gRPC over HTTP/2 (blackbull.grpc): GrpcServiceRegistry, GrpcStatus / GrpcError, Length-Prefixed-Message codec, ASGI bridge (serve_grpc + GrpcContext). gRPC requests multiplex onto the same HTTP/2 port as REST and WebSocket.
app.get_routes() + RouteInfo — public, stable route introspection.
fixed: HTTP/2 large-payload flow-control deadlock — three pre-existing transport bugs surfaced by gRPC conformance, affecting any bidirectional exchange over the 65535-byte initial window.

added: BLACKBULL_* environment-variable + .env resolution for app.run(). Deploy-time settings resolve with documented precedence: explicit run(...) argument → BLACKBULL_* env var → .env file.
RedirectResponse — Response convenience subclass that sets a Location header and a 3xx status.
read_json / read_text — request-body helpers wrapping read_body. Both exported from blackbull.
AsyncAPIExtension — AsyncAPI 3.0 docs for the MQTT broker. Serves an AsyncAPI 3.0 document describing @mqtt.on_message topic taps at /asyncapi.json, plus HTML viewer at /asyncapi.
HTTP now scales across workers alongside a stateful protocol (MQTT). app.run(port=8000, workers=4) with MQTTExtension(port=1883) — master binds protocol port once and hands it to worker 0 only.
changed: Hot-path copy + logging reduction. read_body() joins chunks once; header block accumulated in bytearray (amortised O(1)); per-frame logging is lazy %-args or isEnabledFor-guarded.

added: MQTT 5 broker sidecar (Sprint 52). Pure-Python MQTT 5 broker on the Non-ASGI bridge alongside HTTP. MQTTExtension: mqtt = app.add_extension(MQTTExtension(port=1883)). CONNECT/CONNACK, SUBSCRIBE/UNSUBSCRIBE, PUBLISH at QoS 0/1/2, retained messages, Will (LWT) delivery, keep-alive PING, Clean Start / Session Present.
Non-ASGI protocol bridge (Sprint 50). app.raw_handler(name, *, port=…) registers a raw-TCP protocol alongside HTTP on other ports.
Generic extension mechanism. blackbull.extension.Extension base class; app.add_extension(ext) is the single registration seam.
Unified ProtocolRegistry (Sprint 50). Connection dispatch is now registry-driven instead of hardcoded _dispatch().
changed: MQTT broker rewritten to the actor model (Sprint 53). Single BrokerActor owns all routing/session/retained state (serial inbox ⇒ no locks).

fixed: Middleware send wrappers received Response objects instead of ASGI dicts. Fix: install _wrap_send at the handler boundary in _dispatch.
Router.validate() — forward-ref annotation crash on lifespan startup. Route handlers with string types or PEP 563 annotations caused SyntaxError inside beartype's code generator.

added: AppConfig — declarative startup config. Frozen dataclass holding exactly the parameters run()/serve() accept.
blackbull serve — zero-code static file server. Serves a directory over HTTP/1.1 (and HTTP/2 with TLS) with ETag / 304 conditional requests, directory index, and precompressed-sibling negotiation.

changed: HTTP/2 perf: deferred HEADERS write coalesces HEADERS + DATA into one TCP segment. HTTP2Sender now buffers http.response.start HEADERS frame internally and flushes it together with the first DATA frame in a single write() call.

fixed: RFC 9113 compliance: RST_STREAM and PUSH_PROMISE frames with stream_id == 0 now raise a connection error per RFC 9113 §6.4 and §6.6.

added: Custom HTTP Method Support (Proposal 009 Phase 1). Routes can now be registered and dispatched using non-IANA HTTP method strings such as BREW, PROPFIND, and WHEN from RFC 2324 / RFC 4918. blackbull-htcpcp extension unblocked.

blackbull.fault_injection public module — programmable deliberate-misbehaviour toolkit. H2FaultServer: programmable HTTP/2 server built on hpack + raw RFC 9113 frame layer. HTTP/2 fault catalogue: four spec-grade scenarios (half_closed_stream, exhausted_window, illegal_settings, headers_continuation_dropped). TLS support via make_self_signed_h2_context().
EventSourceResponse — formats each yielded item per the WHATWG SSE grammar. Accepts str, bytes, or Mapping with optional data/event/id/retry keys.
Async generator return type for simplified handlers. A route returning async def stream(): yield ... is auto-wrapped in StreamingResponse.

CapHitCounter gains connection_id field for log correlation across connection-bound records. Dirty-flush triggers: threshold trigger (flush_threshold=, default 100) and interval trigger (flush_interval=, default 60.0 s).

Cap-hit observability (Sprint 44). Every user-tunable resource cap emits one WARNING-level record on blackbull.caps logger when it rejects traffic. Single misbehaving peer cannot flood the log — first hit per (connection, cap) logs in full, subsequent hits silently counted, one summary on connection close. Twelve cap rejection sites wired.

fixed: SocketManager no longer crashes on platforms where socket.AF_UNIX is undefined (notably Windows). Response(headers=[('Foo', 'bar')]) with str-typed tuple elements now accepted — coerced to ASCII bytes per RFC 9110 §5.5.

added: Conformance CI lane (Sprint 43). h2spec + Autobahn external conformance suites wired into GitHub Actions CI alongside docker-free regression replay of HTTP/1.1 differential user-corpus.
changed: WebSocket inbound-frame payload cap default raised from 1 MiB to 64 MiB and made configurable via BB_WS_MAX_FRAME_PAYLOAD env var.

added: Extension surface proven with blackbull-session — the first third-party extension living outside the BlackBull repo, published on PyPI via OIDC trusted publishing.
deprecated: blackbull.middleware.Session now emits DeprecationWarning. Migrate to pip install blackbull-session and from blackbull_session import SessionExtension.

added: blackbull.openapi.OpenAPIExtension — in-tree reference implementation of the init_app(app) extension convention. Supports both eager and deferred construction styles.
BlackBull.extensions: dict[str, object] — namespace for third-party integrations following the init_app(app) convention.
app.on_error(int) — accepts a plain int HTTP status code in addition to HTTPStatus and exception classes.

security: HTTP/2 CONTINUATION header-block size cap (high severity). Mirror HTTP/1.1 BB_HEADER_MAX_TOTAL budget (64 KiB default); emit RST_STREAM(ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM) on over-cap streams.
WebSocket frame payload size cap (medium severity). New _MAX_FRAME_PAYLOAD (default 1 MiB) — check fires before any body bytes are read off the wire.
HTTP/2 inbound RST_STREAM rate limit (high severity — CVE-2023-44487 Rapid Reset). Per-second rolling counter on inbound RST_STREAM frames; over 20/s → GOAWAY(ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM).
added: BB_H2_WS_MAX_STREAMS_PER_CONNECTION (default 5) caps concurrent WebSocket streams per HTTP/2 connection.
blackbull.client.WebSocketH2Client / WebSocketH2Session — public RFC 8441 client built on HTTP2Client.
fixed: Server-side connection-level WINDOW_UPDATE on inbound DATA (RFC 9113 §6.9.1). Any HTTP/2 upload past 65,535 cumulative bytes per connection previously stalled.

added: HTTP/2 response trailers (http.response.trailers). HTTP2 sender now emits HEADERS frame with END_STREAM | END_HEADERS and regular fields only.
BB_REQUEST_TIMEOUT on the HTTP/1.1 path. Previously applied only to HTTP/2 streams. HTTP/1.1 keep-alive loop now wraps each dispatch with asyncio.wait_for guard.
fixed: HTTP1Sender per-request state was sticky across keep-alive requests. _started/_chunked/_buffered_status/_buffered_headers/_expect_trailers now reset between requests.

changed: Brotli default quality lowered from 11 to 4 for Compression middleware's dynamic-response path. q=4 matches Google's and Cloudflare's recommendation for dynamic content.

StaticFiles body cache is now opt-in (default cache=False). Seven framework defaults reset to RFC 7540 / Linux kernel baselines: BB_SOCKET_BACKLOG 4096→128, BB_SOCKET_SNDBUF/RCVBUF 262144→0, BB_SOCKET_REUSEPORT True→False, BB_TCP_USER_TIMEOUT_MS 60000→0, BB_H2_INITIAL_WINDOW_SIZE 1048576→65535, BB_H2_CONNECTION_WINDOW_SIZE 4194304→65535.

added: blackbull.testing.TestClient — synchronous façade over httpx.AsyncClient + httpx.ASGITransport with dedicated background-thread event loop. WebSocketTestSession, WebSocketDisconnect.
__slots__ on per-stream / per-frame hot-path classes: Stream, BaseSender, HTTP1Sender, HTTP2Sender, WebSocketSender.
fixed: BlackBull.__call__ is now correctly ASGI 3.0 compliant under external transports. Apps now run unchanged under uvicorn / hypercorn / granian.

changed: StaticFiles registers common web-asset MIME types at module import: font/woff, font/woff2, image/webp, image/avif, application/wasm. Compression middleware adds font types to skip list.

fixed: README documentation links on PyPI now resolve — changed from GitHub-relative paths to absolute https://github.com/TOKUJI/BlackBull/blob/master/ URLs.

changed: Static cache documents stat()-based invalidation, not permanent staleness. Static cache hits avoid mimetypes.guess_type() regex on every request — mime computed once at cache-store. Static middleware hot path uses os.path instead of pathlib.Path.

added: scope['extensions']['http.response.priority'] — RFC 9218 priority hint at conventional ASGI scope-extensions location.
scope['extensions']['http.response.http2_stream'] — BlackBull HTTP/2 stream-info extension: stream_id, send_window_remaining, connection_send_window_remaining.
http.response.pathsend ASGI extension — zero-copy static-file serving for cleartext HTTP/1.1 via loop.sendfile. 23× throughput improvement on 16 MiB files (25→569 r/s).
BB_WRITE_TIMEOUT (default 30 s) — bounds time spent in StreamWriter.drain() waiting for kernel send buffer to flush. Defends against slow-read slowloris.
changed: BB_KEEP_ALIVE_TIMEOUT default lowered from 60 to 5 seconds. BB_MAX_CONNECTIONS default raised from 0 (disabled) to 1024 per worker with graceful 503 + Retry-After response.

added: Precompressed-variant serving in StaticFiles. When client offers Accept-Encoding: br | gzip | zstd and a .br/.gz/.zst sibling exists on disk, serves that file directly.
Compression executor-queue backpressure. New BB_COMPRESSION_MAX_INFLIGHT (default cpu_count*2). When at cap, additional responses served uncompressed.
fixed: Compression middleware emitted duplicate http.response.start events when upstream response was already encoded. Under HTTP/1.1 keep-alive this caused ~500× throughput drop.

added: KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md — single consolidated doc. bench/soak/ — soak harness (1-hour wrk + tracemalloc). HttpArena comparison harness on EC2 c7i.xlarge.
changed: StaticFiles middleware now caches small files in memory. mtime+size-keyed LRU cache (default ≤ 4 MiB per file, 256 entries). Default error handler is environment-aware (development → full traceback; production → terse).

fixed: beartype promoted from [validation] optional extra to hard dependency — cold pip install blackbull followed by running any app crashed with ModuleNotFoundError.

added: Cascade-multiplier rule pinned in bench/CHARACTERIZATION.md as sprint-gating mechanism. bench/httparena/ scaffold for HttpArena Docker container.
fixed: HTTP/2 query-string scope — :path pseudo-header was copied verbatim into scope['path'] including ?query, and scope['query_string'] was str instead of bytes. Compression middleware Content-Length — upstream Content-Length now stripped and post-compression length written.

changed: Deadline subsystem rework. Per-arm loop.call_later replaced by per-process tick scanner. Per-call cost: 1.69 µs → 350 ns (−79.3%). ConnectionDeadline.guard() is now class-based, saving per-call generator-frame allocation. EC2: B1 +17.4%, B2 +17.1%, B3 +18.3%.

HTTP/1 parser hot-path. URL splitter: urllib.parse.urlparse + re.sub → three bytes.partition calls + slice (−91.6%). Header-loop regex validators: per-byte any(...) → compiled-regex search() (−77.1%). EC2: B1 +13.6% / +15.3%.
Methodology hardening: RUNS_WRK=3 with MAD noise column, DURATION 30→60 s, WARMUP=15 s. Lane E added — connection churn (Connection: close per request) exposing accept-loop + TLS-handshake cost.

asyncio.timeouts.* cost removed from per-request hot path. Replaced per-phase async with asyncio.timeout(d) context managers with single rescheduled loop.call_later() TimerHandle per connection. B1 plaintext +6.5%.

Framework / server separation. Headers + HeaderList moved to top-level blackbull/headers.py. ASGIEvent folded into blackbull/asgi.py. import blackbull no longer transitively loads the server stack. BlackBull.run() is now synchronous.

added: Phase 6 actor-model refactor. Level B event API — @app.on(event) for fire-and-forget, @app.intercept(event) for synchronous interception with call_next chaining. Nine built-in events.
Actor model: Message dataclass base, Actor base class with queue-based inbox. HTTP1Actor, HTTP2Actor, WebSocketActor, ConnectionActor — protocol actors as the sole runtime path.
blackbull.client/ — async client package: HTTP1Client, HTTP2Client, WebSocketClient, Client (ALPN-dispatching).
changed: Middleware re-implemented as intercept sugar. app.use(mw), middlewares=[...], @app.on_startup, @app.on_shutdown, @app.on_error(status) all lower to @app.intercept registrations.
